# clickhouse_postgres_private_endpoint (Resource)

~> **Note:** This resource is in beta and its behavior may change in future provider versions.

Creates a private endpoint service for [ClickHouse Cloud Managed Postgres](https://clickhouse.com/cloud/postgres),
so VPC endpoints in your AWS account can connect over AWS PrivateLink:

1. Create this resource. It waits until the service is available, which takes about 5 to 10 minutes.
2. Create an `aws_vpc_endpoint` with `service_name = endpoint_service_name` in the Postgres service's region.
3. Allow the VPC endpoint with `clickhouse_postgres_private_endpoint_attachment`.
4. Once AWS shows the VPC endpoint as available, turn on its private DNS. The VPC also needs DNS hostnames and
   DNS resolution turned on.
5. Connect to `private_hostname` from that VPC.

~> **Note:** Postgres private endpoints are available only for AWS Postgres services, and only once they are enabled
for your organization. Contact ClickHouse support to enable access.

## Supported lifecycle

- Create
- Read
- Delete. Deleting waits until the private endpoint service is gone.
- Import by Postgres service ID

Changing `postgres_id` replaces the private endpoint service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clickhouse_postgres_service" "example" {
  ...
}

resource "clickhouse_postgres_private_endpoint" "example" {
  postgres_id = clickhouse_postgres_service.example.id
}

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "postgres" {
  vpc_id             = aws_vpc.example.id
  service_name       = clickhouse_postgres_private_endpoint.example.endpoint_service_name
  vpc_endpoint_type  = "Interface"
  subnet_ids         = [aws_subnet.example.id]
  security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.postgres.id]
}

resource "clickhouse_postgres_private_endpoint_attachment" "example" {
  postgres_id = clickhouse_postgres_private_endpoint.example.postgres_id
  allowed_vpc_endpoints = {
    (aws_vpc_endpoint.postgres.id) = { description = "Application VPC" }
  }
}

output "postgres_private_hostname" {
  value = clickhouse_postgres_private_endpoint.example.private_hostname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `postgres_id` (String) ID of the AWS Postgres service. Changing it replaces the private endpoint service.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_service_name` (String) AWS endpoint service name. Use it as the `service_name` of an `aws_vpc_endpoint`.
- `private_hostname` (String) Hostname for connecting to the Postgres service through an allowed VPC endpoint.
- `state` (String) State of the private endpoint service, such as `available`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# A Postgres private endpoint can be imported by specifying the Postgres service ID.
terraform import clickhouse_postgres_private_endpoint.example xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
```
